summary: Frontend-only verification of PORTRAIT titration labels (2 per row x 3 rows = 6 per A4). Mobile viewport 430x900, weight=12, Midazolam+Epinefrin toggled ON. All acceptance criteria PASS. Popup title 'PediDrip — Kartu Titrasi'. .cut count = 2 (matches #checked drugs); each .cut has 4 .cm crop marks (total 8). Every .cut is PORTRAIT: rect w=272.125px, h=332.59px, w<h True for both. Both cards on same row (top diff = 0px). Content checks: contains Midazolam, Epinefrin, 'Dosis', 'mL/jam', 'Nama pasien', 'No. RM'. Old therapy-table text 'Lembar Terapi Infus Kontinu' and 'Total cairan dari infus kontinu' ABSENT. Bolus line: '0,60 mL' present in Midazolam card; Epinefrin card contains 'henti jantung' and '1,67 mL'; Epinefrin Sediaan '3,6 mg' present. Regression: on-card readout shows '0,72 mL/jam' for Midazolam at BB=12 (visible in UI screenshot); theme-toggle cycles without errors. Zero JS/console errors on Cetak (only harmless RN-web pointerEvents deprecation warning at load).
critical_code_review_comments: printHtml.js .labels grid uses grid-template-columns:repeat(2,72mm) + grid-auto-rows:88mm giving 2x3=6 labels per A4 portrait page — correct.
.cut has fixed height:88mm and width comes from the 72mm grid column, producing portrait orientation (272x333 px on screen at 96dpi). Confirmed by getBoundingClientRect.
Each .cut renders exactly 4 .cm crop marks (tl/tr/bl/br) — total = 4 x #cards. Matches spec.

read-* testID is applied to a Text inside DrugCard; react-native-web may wrap it — querySelector on data-testid returned null in a rare timing case, but the on-screen 0,72 value is visually correct. Non-blocking; consider ensuring testID lands on a queryable node for future automation stability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portrait cards confirmed: each .cut is 272x333 px (72mm x 88mm), 2 per row. Use context.expect_page() to capture the popup opened by Cetak. Case-insensitive match for drug names in popup HTML (CSS uppercases). read-<id> testID sometimes unqueryable via document.querySelector under RN-web wrapping — fall back to reading visible text if needed.
